# Mimi

> Mimi is a team of AI agents on WhatsApp for FMCG distributors and brands in Nigeria. It collects what shops owe, checks every transfer with the bank to catch fake alerts, checks each van against what shops received, and shows brands what really sold, shop by shop. Shops use it free.

Mimi is built by Rail Technology Concepts Ltd (RC 9322751), Ado-Ekiti, Nigeria. The company was called Rail Money before; Rail Money is now Mimi (https://userail.money/new-name). Mimi is in early access and pilots are by invitation. Website: https://userail.money

## Key facts
- Who it is for: FMCG distributors, the brands they carry, and the retail shops (provision stores, kiosks, supermarkets) they supply.
- What it is: distributor software that runs on WhatsApp, with a web console for the distributor's team. Not an ERP and not a payment app.
- Where it works: inside WhatsApp. Reps and shops keep using the app they already use: text, voice notes, notebook photos, forwarded bank alerts.
- Collections: Mimi reminds shops what they owe and matches each payment to the right shop.
- Fake bank alerts: a payment counts as verified only when the rep, the shop and the bank agree ("three witnesses for every naira"). Fake alerts get flagged.
- Route checks: each van's delivery is checked against what shops say they received.
- Sell-through for brands: with each shop's consent, brands see weekly sell-through and promo proof. Brands see totals by default, never another brand's sales.
- Mimi never holds or moves money. Payments settle straight to the distributor's own account.
- Distributors set credit limits. Mimi suggests, people decide. Nothing goes out without a person approving it.
- Shops own their data, and Mimi is built with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA) in mind.
- Free for shops, always.

## Pricing (pilot pricing, to be confirmed with pilot distributors)
- Growth: ₦2,000 per active shop per month, ₦100,000 monthly minimum. Collector, fake-alert checks, WhatsApp reorders, stock-out alerts, owner brief.
- Pro: ₦3,500 per active shop per month, ₦200,000 monthly minimum. Adds Proof (van checks), credit-limit suggestions, receivables aging, exports and API.
- Shops: free.
- A free pilot comes first. Details: https://userail.money/pricing

## The helpers
Mimi routes each ask to one of six helpers: Order (takes orders), Collector (chases payments), Credit (watches limits), Stock (counts stock), Brand (reports to brands) and Proof (checks receipts).

## The console
Distributor teams work with Mimi in a web console (live demo, your own copy of a made-up distributor: https://demo.userail.money):
- Threads: ask Mimi in plain language (collections, restock, onboarding, credit) and follow each run step by step, including what its cloud computer is doing on screen.
- Approvals: every payment plan, restock order or brand email waits as a draft until a person approves it.
- Shops: each shop's sell-through, outstanding balance, payments (verified or self-reported) and credit score.
- Credit: Mimi recommends limit changes with reasons; only the distributor can set a limit.
- Settings: connectors (WhatsApp Business, Google Sheets, Gmail, Paystack and more), computers, members, shop access rules and usage.
